original_prompt: Create an original Sidi Saiyyed jaali-inspired geometric lattice panel with a clear unbroken frame. Use repeated intersecting stone-like openings, keep a connected structural web at least two pixels thick, preserve D2 symmetry, and keep the open fraction moderate.

Never use name, dots, type, cx, or centre as field names.
